title: DmelPPI
ids: FlyBase polypeptide (FBpp) -- the isoform DmelPPI folded. FBgn, gene symbol, isoform symbol and UniProt accession are carried per protein (fb_2026_03 / r6.67, with the authors' own mapping where fb_2026_03 has no row).

source.name: DmelPPI
source.citation: Peng J, Zhao L. A predicted structural interactome reveals binding interference from intrinsically disordered regions. PLOS Computational Biology 22, e1013899 (2026); preprint bioRxiv 2025.08.15.670535.

data.role: models, PAE and per-pair metadata as used here
the same models and PAE, served per pair from the authors' public bucket
FBpp to FBgn / symbol / UniProt mapping, from the authors

source.predictor: AlphaFold2-Multimer; the authors released one of five models per pair, the one they ranked highest
source.selection: Drosophila melanogaster protein pairs with a STRING score >= 0.9

paeSource.file: pae_raw.zip (figshare 30582146); identical, cell for cell, to the public bucket mPAE files
paeSource.note: The source publishes PAE on these 17 levels only: 0.5 A steps below 5 A, 1.0 A steps from 5 to 13 A, clipped at 1 and 13. pae_raw.zip stores them as integer half-angstroms (value = integer / 2) and equals the bucket mPAE value in every cell on the 8 pairs checked (2026-10-07). There is no full-precision PAE in the record, so scores here inherit this quantization; the effect below was measured by snapping full-precision ColabFold PAE (0.01 A) to the same 17 levels and rescoring with this same lis.py. The error is NOT symmetric: on that sample iLIS and LIS moved down or not at all, never up, so an iLIS here is a slight under-estimate and the positive counts are a floor, not a ceiling.

iLIS.direction: quantization only ever lowers this score

LIS.direction: quantization only ever lowers this score

pTMSource.note: DmelPPI publishes no pTM: the deposited NPZ/json metadata carry iptm only, and pTM is a global AlphaFold confidence output that cannot be derived from the released PAE or pLDDT. The column therefore ships empty rather than as a value. v0.1.7 of this screen wrote the literal string "nan" in all 55,422 bundle rows; v0.1.7b writes an empty cell, which is the convention every other Atlas screen uses for a quantity the source does not provide.

analysis.modelsPerPair: 1 served of 5 folded: the authors released the model they ranked highest, so rank is always 1 and iLIS_best == iLIS_avg.
analysis.structures: not served: the bundles hold scores, maps and sequences only. The authors' models are on figshare (10.6084/m9.figshare.30582146).
